the labeling charter operationalizes the estimate/fact/inference discipline the revenue method requires
because revenue is book/roster-funded not foot-traffic, the referral graph that builds the book is the moat
the carrier/lender/MLS/referral relationships are the concrete expression of the referral-and-supply graph
the E&O and immigration-consultant bonding layer sits on top of the base license-to-operate gate
the returns-per-preparer benchmark and size signal produce the solo and full-CPA tax bands
the PTIN/CTEC/CPA-EA license gate is the right-to-operate condition on the tax firm
the pro tax engines are the signature recurring input of the accounting/tax cost center
the carrier-commission mechanic and renewal book are the revenue engine of the agency model
the carrier-appointment/cluster supply universe is the precondition for the agency to quote and bind
carrier-required E&O is the bonding condition for the agency's appointments to stand
the per-side GCI and 70/30 split mechanic is the revenue engine of the brokerage
the MLS, title/escrow and lender nodes feed the brokerage transaction pipeline
the incumbent referral graph is the binding entry barrier for a new brokerage brand
the capped-fee and loan-signing benchmarks produce the notary-alone and bundled bands
the Spanish-speaking and immigrant communities are the demand anchor for the multiservicios bundle
the $100k immigration-consultant bond is the binding regulatory cost of the immigration-doc line
the bonding regime and the legal-advice scope cap jointly bound the immigration-doc format
the scope constraint caps which lines the multiservicios shop may monetize
the tax Jan-Apr crush is the cadence the seasonality node generalizes and ties to stacking
the trust-community demand is the raiser that keeps the count from falling below benchmark
the two-sided leakage is the capper in the saturation synthesis
the saturated-once-captives-counted insurance read feeds the synthesis
the floor-not-ceiling caveat qualifies every density read in the saturation synthesis
the saturation read is the demand-headroom lens of the merged enter/avoid verdict
the bond gate is the binding regulatory condition on the multiservicios and insurance verdicts
whether an entrant can break the referral graph is the moat lens of the verdict
trust-community demand pushes the viable count up while the Modesto/online leakage pulls it down, and a format read can over-weight one
edges.resolution_rule: apply trust-community depth to relationship-loyal multilingual formats and the Modesto/online cap to complex or commodity cross-shopped work; when both bear on one sub-category, let the more price-sensitive or more cross-shopped force dominate the saturation read

edges.why_related: the independent-only insurance density reads below benchmark while the uncounted captives make it saturated, tempting a false white-space read
edges.resolution_rule: treat the 0.83/10k independent figure as a floor and read insurance as saturated once captive State Farm/Farmers/Allstate offices are added; do not recommend commodity entry on the below-benchmark independent count alone

edges.why_related: a sourced commission rate is a fact while its application to a named book is an estimate, tempting a false upgrade to a stated revenue fact
edges.resolution_rule: keep the rate labeled [FACT] but its application to any Turlock book labeled [ESTIMATE]; never present a firm revenue figure as fact and carry method, source and confidence with every number

edges.why_related: clearing the license is necessary but not sufficient because the referral-graph moat is the binding barrier above it
observed producer/agent split and commission realities feed back to refine the payroll-share backbone for these formats
the immigration-consultant bonding regime exists because the legal-advice scope is statutorily constrained, so the bond and the scope cap co-bound the format

conflict_axes.name: benchmark_estimate_vs_stated_fact
conflict_axes.description: A sourced industry benchmark (commission rate, returns-per-preparer) conflicts with the temptation to present its application to a named firm as a stated revenue fact.
poles: report the benchmark application as fact
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: label the rate a [FACT] but its application to any book an [ESTIMATE], and never state a named firm's revenue as fact

conflict_axes.name: trust_community_depth_vs_modesto_online_cap
conflict_axes.description: Trust/language communities raise the viable format count while Modesto and online disruptors cap it; a format read can over-weight either force.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: apply community depth to relationship-loyal multilingual formats and the leakage cap to complex/commodity cross-shopped work

conflict_axes.name: independent_count_vs_coverage_floor
conflict_axes.description: The independent-only catalog reads a sub-category below benchmark while uncounted captives/chains make it saturated, so the count is a floor not a ceiling.
poles: read the independent count as the density
treat it as a floor under true supply
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: treat every density as a lower bound; read insurance as saturated once captives are added

conflict_axes.name: high_gross_vs_thin_net
conflict_axes.description: High-commission/GCI formats (full CPA firm, multi-line agency) can post strong gross while netting modestly after ~40-60% payroll, so gross must never be read as profit.
poles: respect the thin net after payroll
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: always pair the gross band with the payroll-and-expense backbone before judging attractiveness

conflict_axes.name: license_clearance_vs_referral_moat
conflict_axes.description: Clearing the license lets entry begin but the incumbent referral graph is the binding barrier, so a cleared credential is not an open market.
poles: treat the license as the hard part
treat the referral graph as the real barrier
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: budget the license but condition entry on breaking into the referral graph the incumbents hold

conflict_axes.name: notary_alone_vs_bundled_viability
conflict_axes.description: The fee-capped notary line does not pencil standalone while the stacked multiservicios bundle does, so demand is real only when monetized stacked.
poles: stack lines into a multiservicios bundle
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: treat the notary line as viable only bundled with tax/translation/bookkeeping under the fee cap and scope constraint

conflict_axes.name: demographic_demand_vs_legal_scope_cap
conflict_axes.description: Real immigrant-community demand for immigration help conflicts with the B&P §22440 prohibition on giving legal advice, capping the monetizable scope.
poles: stay within form-filling and refer out
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: restrict to form-filling, translation and notarization and make the attorney/accredited-rep referral structural

conflict_axes.name: brokerage_brand_whitespace_vs_agent_crowding
conflict_axes.description: A differentiated brokerage brand has white-space while the agent tier is crowded, so opening a brand differs sharply from adding an agent.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: treat the brand level as the open lane and the agent tier as crowded and cyclically squeezed

conflict_axes.name: seasonal_peak_revenue_vs_offseason_cash_drag
conflict_axes.description: Tax-season and refi-cycle peaks concentrate revenue while off-season drags cash, so an annual band hides the working-capital reality.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: model working capital across the cadence, not the annual average, for tax and notary/immigration formats and use stacking to smooth

edge_cases.description: A named firm's revenue is requested or asserted as an actual figure
edge_cases.trigger: a question demands the real commission, GCI or fees of a specific Turlock firm
edge_cases.mitigation: refuse to state actual revenue; provide only a labeled benchmark estimate with method, source, confidence and a roster/sales-tax confirmation path

edge_cases.description: A sourced commission rate is applied to a named agency's book and reported as a revenue fact
edge_cases.trigger: an answer multiplies a commission rate by an inferred book and states the product as fact
edge_cases.mitigation: keep the rate [FACT] but its application [ESTIMATE]; never present the product as a firm's actual revenue

edge_cases.description: Insurance is read as below-benchmark white-space on the independent count while captives make it saturated
edge_cases.trigger: a density read uses the 0.83/10k independent-only figure as the true supply
edge_cases.mitigation: treat the figure as a floor and read insurance as saturated once captive State Farm/Farmers/Allstate offices are added

edge_cases.description: A multiservicios shop crosses the legal-advice line on an immigration matter
edge_cases.trigger: a form-filling task drifts into advising on a case under B&P §22440
edge_cases.mitigation: restrict to form-filling, translation and notarization and refer the matter to an attorney or accredited representative

edge_cases.description: A standalone notary shop is planned on the ~$15/signature fee cap without bundling
edge_cases.trigger: a notary-only concept budgets on plain notarization volume
edge_cases.mitigation: treat the notary line as viable only stacked with tax/translation/bookkeeping; rely on loan-signings for the margin within the line

edge_cases.description: An immigration-doc line is launched without the $100,000 immigration-consultant bond
edge_cases.trigger: a multiservicios plan budgets the cheap notary bond but not the immigration bond
edge_cases.mitigation: secure and price the $100k immigration-consultant bond before doing immigration-doc work

edge_cases.description: The full-CPA-firm revenue band is cited without its unknown-staff-count caveat
edge_cases.trigger: an answer quotes the $400k-$1.2M+ band as a firm figure
edge_cases.mitigation: flag the band as the sector's lowest-confidence number, resting on an unknown staff count, and label it estimate

edge_cases.description: The real-estate per-agent net is read as a Turlock agent's actual income
edge_cases.trigger: the <$50k-$110k figure is quoted as a local fact
edge_cases.mitigation: label it a national NAR/Indeed survey benchmark, not a Turlock fact, and pair it with the rate-cycle lumpiness caveat

edge_cases.description: A carrier/lender/MLS link is upgraded from inference to a stated contract
edge_cases.trigger: an answer asserts a specific firm carries a named carrier without a source
edge_cases.mitigation: keep relationship links labeled representative inference except the documented Tom Michael/Mercury case

edge_cases.description: A demand-true wedge is treated as enterable while the referral moat or bond blocks it
edge_cases.trigger: an enter verdict ignores the referral graph, license or bond
edge_cases.mitigation: run every wedge through the license/bond gate and the referral-graph break-in before issuing an enter verdict

edge_cases.description: A tax-software price hike compresses a thin-margin CPA firm's net
edge_cases.trigger: a Lacerte/UltraTax subscription increase outruns fee growth
edge_cases.mitigation: treat the software subscription as the dominant recurring input and the price-hike, not a stockout, as the resilience risk

workflow.action: Size the resident, household and farm-economy demand floor
workflow.description: State the population, household, income and farm-economy figures as cited facts or labeled estimates
workflow.gate: population, household count, median income, family-household share and farm-economy demand are stated with sources

workflow.action: Map trust/language anchors to the formats they sustain
workflow.description: Tie each community share to its anchored multilingual format and durability
workflow.gate: all four communities have cited shares and named anchored formats

workflow.description: Identify which complex work leaks to Modesto and which commodity work leaks online
workflow.gate: Modesto role/distance stated, up-and-online leakage named, and the defensible middle identified

workflow.action: Lay down the labor-and-license cost backbone
workflow.description: State the near-zero-COGS payroll/expense/occupancy/E&O backbone with sources
workflow.gate: the payroll share, expense ratio, occupancy and E&O lines are stated as cited planning priors

workflow.action: Set the labeled-estimate revenue method and honesty charter
workflow.description: Define benchmark-times-size-signal banding with the estimate label, confidence and confirmation path, and the binding label scheme
workflow.gate: every band carries the estimate-not-actual label, a confidence, a size signal and a confirmation source

workflow.action: State the commission/GCI/fee mechanics and referral moat
workflow.description: Explain the commission/GCI/fee revenue and split mechanics and the referral-graph moat
workflow.gate: the commission/GCI/fee mechanics, the splits and the book/roster-as-asset are stated

workflow.action: Map the supply universe and software stack per sub-category
workflow.description: Name the carrier/cluster, EFIN/FTB, MLS/title-escrow and signing-service nodes plus the software anchor as inference
workflow.gate: each sub-category has named relationship and software nodes with the inference label

workflow.action: Establish the licensing, bond and E&O gates
workflow.description: State the DOI/DRE/CTEC/SoS licenses, the E&O and the $100k immigration bond per sub-category
workflow.gate: the right-to-operate licenses and the E&O/immigration-bond gates are stated with sources

workflow.description: For each sub-category, state lines of service, cost center, splits, labeled band and saturation tie
workflow.gate: each sub-category names its cost center, labeled band and the gate or moat that decides viability

workflow.action: Synthesize the per-sub-category saturation and floor caveat
workflow.description: Give the saturated/crowded/moderate/white-space read with density floors and the coverage-floor caveat
workflow.gate: each sub-category has a saturation read with its density floor and the floor-not-ceiling caveat is stated

workflow.action: Issue the merged sub-category enter/avoid verdict
workflow.description: Intersect demand headroom, the license/bond gate, the referral moat and margin reality into an enter/avoid call
workflow.gate: the verdict states the saturation floor, binding license/bond gate, referral barrier and margin reality and is conditioned on clearing the gate and the moat

dominance_rules.rule: The honesty label dominates any revenue claim
dominance_rules.rationale: no per-business revenue is public, so a band may never be presented as an actual figure
dominance_rules.trigger: any dollar figure is attached to a named firm or format
dominance_rules.action: tag it estimate-not-actual with method, source, a confidence and a confirmation path, and refuse an actual-revenue claim

dominance_rules.rule: The coverage floor dominates any density-based white-space read
dominance_rules.rationale: the catalog counts only verifiable independents, so every density is a lower bound on true supply
dominance_rules.trigger: a sub-category is called open on its independent-only density
dominance_rules.action: treat the density as a floor and read insurance as saturated once captives are counted

dominance_rules.rule: The referral moat dominates license clearance in any entry verdict
dominance_rules.rationale: clearing the license is necessary but the incumbent referral graph is the binding barrier
dominance_rules.trigger: an enter recommendation rests on a cleared credential alone
dominance_rules.action: condition entry on breaking into the referral graph the incumbents hold

dominance_rules.rule: Net after payroll dominates gross commission/GCI in judging attractiveness
dominance_rules.rationale: high-gross formats net modestly after the ~40-60% payroll share, so gross must not be read as profit
dominance_rules.trigger: a format is judged by its commission/GCI band alone
dominance_rules.action: pair the band with the payroll-and-expense backbone before deciding

dominance_rules.rule: The legal-advice scope cap dominates the immigration-doc demand
dominance_rules.rationale: B&P §22440 prohibits giving legal advice regardless of how deep the demand is
dominance_rules.trigger: a multiservicios line moves toward advising on an immigration matter
dominance_rules.action: restrict to form-filling/translation/notarization and refer to an attorney or accredited representative

dominance_rules.rule: The immigration-consultant bond dominates the cheap-notary-bond illusion
dominance_rules.rationale: the $100k immigration bond, not the $38 notary bond, is the real gate on the immigration-doc line
dominance_rules.trigger: an immigration-doc line is planned on the notary bond alone
dominance_rules.action: secure and price the $100k immigration-consultant bond before doing immigration-doc work

dominance_rules.rule: Bundling dominates the standalone notary line
dominance_rules.rationale: the fee-capped notary line does not pencil unstacked, so viability requires the multiservicios bundle
dominance_rules.trigger: a standalone notary concept is proposed
dominance_rules.action: default to the stacked multiservicios model and rely on loan-signings for the in-line margin

dominance_rules.rule: The brokerage brand dominates the agent tier for real-estate entry
dominance_rules.rationale: the agent tier is crowded while a differentiated brand has white-space
dominance_rules.trigger: an entry is framed as adding another agent
dominance_rules.action: reframe toward a differentiated brokerage brand and treat the agent tier as crowded

dominance_rules.rule: Documented links dominate inferred supply links
dominance_rules.rationale: only Tom Michael's Mercury listing is an evidenced relationship; the rest is representative inference
dominance_rules.action: label it inference unless it is the documented Mercury case

anti_rework_rules.rule: Attach the estimate-not-actual label and confidence when the band is first produced, not after review
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a revenue figure circulating as a fact and having to be retracted

anti_rework_rules.rule: Read every density as a floor and add captives before calling a sub-category open
anti_rework_rules.prevents: recommending entry into a falsely-open sub-category like insurance

anti_rework_rules.rule: Condition every enter verdict on breaking into the referral graph, not just clearing the license
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an entry plan stalling on the incumbent referral moat the license did not address

anti_rework_rules.rule: Price the $100k immigration-consultant bond before scoping an immigration-doc line
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a multiservicios launch stalling on the unbudgeted immigration bond

anti_rework_rules.rule: Restrict the multiservicios scope to form-filling and refer legal matters out from the outset
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a notario-fraud exposure that must later be unwound

anti_rework_rules.rule: Pair every commission/GCI band with its net-after-payroll backbone in the same step
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a high-gross format being approved before the thin net is seen

anti_rework_rules.rule: Model seasonal working capital, not the annual band, for tax and notary/immigration formats
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a plan failing on an off-season cash crunch the annual band hid

anti_rework_rules.rule: Keep carrier/lender/MLS links labeled inference from the outset
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an inferred relationship hardening into an asserted contract that must later be corrected

anti_rework_rules.rule: Flag the full-CPA-firm band as lowest-confidence whenever it is quoted
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an unknown-staff-count band anchoring a decision as if it were firm

iteration_protocol.trigger: a CA DOI/DRE/CTEC license-roster pull for the 95380/95382 ZIPs or CDTFA/BLS occupational data becomes available
iteration_protocol.action: replace the labeled density floors and revenue bands with confirmed figures and re-rank confidence

iteration_protocol.trigger: a Census ACS refresh changes population, income or ancestry shares
iteration_protocol.action: re-size the demand floor and re-map the trust anchors and saturation reads

iteration_protocol.trigger: a commission-rate, per-side or returns-per-preparer benchmark is revised
iteration_protocol.action: update the affected revenue mechanics and the per-sub-category bands

iteration_protocol.trigger: a DOI/DRE/CTEC/SoS license fee, notary fee cap or immigration-consultant bond changes
iteration_protocol.action: re-evaluate the licensing/bond gate and the multiservicios and insurance verdicts

iteration_protocol.trigger: a firm opens or closes, changing a per-sub-category count
iteration_protocol.action: update the saturation read and the merged enter/avoid for that sub-category

iteration_protocol.trigger: a captive office, national chain or solo-EA count is measured
iteration_protocol.action: convert the coverage-floor caveat from directional to measured and re-rank the saturated reads

iteration_protocol.trigger: the rate cycle, USCIS policy or Turlock median home price shifts
iteration_protocol.action: update the cadence and the real-estate and notary/immigration models

iteration_protocol.trigger: a tax-engine, AMS or MLS software price or platform changes
iteration_protocol.action: update the software anchor and the affected format cost centers

priority_rationale: The demand floor, trust anchors and Modesto/online leakage come first because every sub-category judgment depends on knowing the size and shape of bounded local demand; the labor-and-license cost backbone, labeled-revenue method and honesty charter, commission/GCI/fee mechanics, referral moat and supply-and-software map next, because they are the lenses that turn demand into unit economics without ever stating a firm's revenue as fact; the licensing, bond and E&O gates next, because they confer the right to operate independent of demand; the four sub-category models then apply all of that to the named firms; and the saturation synthesis, coverage-floor caveat and merged enter/avoid verdict come last because they compose every upstream output into a defensible enter/avoid verdict that keeps every density read a floor.
